title: gravity.override_activated
description: M14B § gravity field producer — fires the first tick an actor enters the spatial extent of a gravity override (uniform_well, region_low_g, reverse_g, damaged_grav) or equips magnetic boots. `override_id` is the manifest-authored id; `kind` is one of `uniform_well|region_low_g|magnetic_boots|reverse_g|damaged_grav`; `actor_id` is the actor whose gravity vector changed this tick. Producer fills at M14B. Additive-only per M4 DR-002.
